_comment: The A-axis roof per deliverable class (see src/lib/status/craft.ts). Each ceiling records the project's explicit market assumption. 'permanent' = assumed never to move (generative 3D/animation will not reach top tier); 'arguable' = revisit as the model market moves; 'uncapped' = the long-term chase (LLMs are expected to reach AAA parity here). A step AT its ceiling renders as achievement, never amber shame. Changing a ceiling is a product decision — record why in the reason.

text-config.reason: Design docs, systems specs, balance and config text — LLMs are expected to reach AAA-parity writing and systems design.

graph-data.reason: Quest DAGs, state machines, dialogue trees — structured design output LLMs are expected to master.

ue-runtime.reason: Runtime code, gates and UE-side assets driven from code — AAA-grade code generation is the core market bet.

audio.reason: SFX, music and voice generation (ElevenLabs class and beyond) are expected to reach professional parity.

vfx-particles.reason: Effect specs and Niagara graphs are authored as code/config; any capped mesh inputs are covered by the 3d-mesh ceiling.

2d-art.reason: Image models arguably reach AA today; AAA key-art parity is unproven. Revisit as image models move.

3d-mesh.reason: Assumed permanent: generative 3D modelling will not reach top-tier AAA asset quality. Reaching A2 here IS the roof.

animation.reason: Assumed permanent: generative animation will not reach AAA motion quality (hand-keyed + mocap pipelines). Reaching A2 here IS the roof.
